task.description: Produce a design artefact for EE-09 (Variable scoping and merge). The design must cover: (1) the mergeVariables function signature and location — this is a CALLER concern (instance.zig / persistence layer), NOT inside transition.zig which must remain pure; (2) the three-path collision policy: (a) new key → insert, (b) existing key + schema-compatible value → overwrite + append VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event, (c) existing key + schema-rejected value → do NOT apply merge, transition instance to ERROR, append EXECUTION_ERROR event with error type 'SCHEMA_VIOLATION', affected field, reason, and variable state at time of error; (3) schema validation mechanism — how per-variable schemas are stored and checked (referenced from the instance variable schema map); (4) empty output_variables={} is a no-op — no VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN events; (5) how the merged variable map is passed back into the transition function for immediate use by subsequent CEL evaluations (EE-05); (6) integration point with task completion (completeTask in instance.zig step sequence — merge happens BEFORE processNodeEntry); (7) integration with parallel join (EE-07) — collision policy applies at join when two branches produce the same key; (8) VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event payload schema: {event_type, instance_id, task_id, key, old_value, new_value, merged_at}; (9) EXECUTION_ERROR event payload for SCHEMA_VIOLATION; (10) DB transaction atomicity — merge + event INSERT + projection UPDATE must be a single transaction. Update src/design/engine.md with a new EE-09 section. engine.md already has placeholder text at lines ~772-776 saying 'A separate design section will cover EE-09 in detail' — fill that section.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/engine.md has a new EE-09 section with mergeVariables function signature, three-path collision policy pseudocode, schema validation design, and DB transaction design
Design covers all four acceptance criteria from EE-09 in BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md
Design covers both edge cases: empty output_variables (no-op) and duplicate key in one task's JSON (last-value-wins before merge)
Design is consistent with existing engine.md conventions, the backend_developer_guide.md §6 format, and the existing EE-04/EE-08 sections
Design clearly states that mergeVariables is a CALLER concern (instance.zig), not inside transition.zig

result.summary: Design artefact for EE-09 (Variable scoping and merge): mergeVariables function signature and location (instance.zig, caller concern), three-path collision policy pseudocode (new key / overwrite+VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN / schema-violation+EXECUTION_ERROR), schema validation via variable_schemas table (migration 012), empty no-op edge case, merged-map pass-through for CEL evaluation (EE-05), completeTask integration step sequence, parallel join collision handling (EE-07), both event payload schemas (VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN + EXECUTION_ERROR), and DB transaction atomicity layout. Token.output_variables field addition to transition.zig specified (pure data, no I/O).
